results.title: Senyum Manies: Love Story
results.overview: Biopic film about the love story of Anies Baswedan and Fery Farhati while studying in Yogyakarta.

results.title: Cinghia
results.overview: A man loses his mother to the COVID-19 pandemic. Driven to madness by grief, he embarks on a killing spree targeting anyone who breaks quarantine rules. A podcaster and a policewoman investigate the case.

results.title: Believe: The Ultimate Battle
results.overview: The son of a veteran named Agus was faced with the shadow of his father's absence, so he grew up to be an undisciplined child. Until the veteran died and made his son follow in his father's footsteps to enter the military world.

results.title: Lost Voyages: Phase II and the Rebirth of Star Trek
results.original_title: Lost Voyages: Phase II and the Rebirth of Star Trek
results.overview: Explores the unproduced "Star Trek: Phase II", Gene Roddenberry's proposed 1970s revival of "Star Trek", and the forces that led to its demise. Featuring digital renders created by the Roddenberry Archive and OTOY, of the starship Enterprise and the command bridge as they had been redesigned and built – but never completed.

results.title: Bumblebee's Summer
results.overview: On a remote Adriatic island a group of children discovers a mysterious boy hidden in a nearby lighthouse. Convinced he’s an alien, imaginative Karlo from Zagreb rallies the gang on a mission to return him “home.” But when local boy Bumbar learns that the little one is actually an African refugee, the adventure turns into a struggle for justice and friendship.

results.title: Downhill Skiers – Ain't No Mountain Steep Enough
results.original_title: Downhill Skiers – Ain't No Mountain Steep Enough
results.overview: A downhill run is two minutes of skiing at the limit, a feat of strength between triumph and tragedy. The risk of a fall or serious injury is always present. The thrill prevails and is almost addictive, regardless of all the side effects.

results.title: China Moses @ Jazzopen Stuttgart 2025
results.overview: The daughter of Dee Dee Bridgewater, soul singer China Moses is renowned for collaborating with artists such as Guru, DJ Mehdi and Meshell Ndegeocello. In France, she is also known as a presenter for MTV and TSF Jazz.

results.title: BABY FAT
results.overview: When a stocky Filipino-American tween spills ketchup on a traditional heirloom dress, she must accompany her mother to the laundromat where her attempts to restore it only make her feel more displaced in her own skin.

results.title: Gimme
results.overview: On the first night of Hanukkah, a grandfather and his estranged granddaughter are pulled into a sinister game of dreidel.

results.title: Turtle Pleasure
results.overview: A turtle makes a couple of phone calls.

results.title: Le Cirque Phénix - 25 ans
results.overview: For twenty-five years, Cirque Phénix has been pushing the boundaries of spectacular entertainment. A quarter of a century of innovation, creativity, and wonder. To celebrate this exceptional anniversary, Cirque Phénix invites you to discover "Millésime – 25 Years of Audacity and Emotion," a brand-new show bringing together the best artists who have marked our history and new talents who will shape the future of the circus. Breathtaking acrobatics, spectacular staging, extraordinary artistic intensity.

results.title: Arman
results.overview: Feeling overwhelmed and isolated on the day of his wedding, Arman, a gay, closeted immigrant, has to lie to his family on the phone about his marriage in the U.S. Moments before walking down the aisle, he is uncertain how to move forward.

results.title: Chokkor 302
results.overview: When a young man is murdered, Inspector Mainul begins what seems like a straightforward case. But as he digs deeper, hidden truths, shifting motives, and shocking twists begin to unravel, turning the investigation into a gripping race to uncover the real killer.

results.title: Cowboy
results.overview: In New Orleans, war veterans Juno and Mo scrape by on small-time heists, selling their loot to a secretive pawn shop owner. When Juno plans a risky horse theft to fund a fresh start, a rival's betrayal leads to tragedy and prison. Haunted by his past, he reenters a woman's life under a lie, desperate for forgiveness.

results.title: Finding Father Christmas
results.overview: A 16-year-old boy goes on a quest to prove his dad wrong and that actually Father Christmas does exist.

results.title: The Creature
results.overview: A man encounters a monster-like creature at night, and he is unsure if it’s real or not since the passing of his good friend.

results.title: Drunkenheimer
results.overview: Theta Sigma Phi is in crisis - no girls are showing up to their parties and their legendary jungle-themed bash is about to flop. Enter Bobby Drunkenheimer, a STEM student with a dangerously brilliant idea: combine every type of alcohol into one new mysterious, potent concoction - Jungle Juice. Will Bobby’s bold new creation turn the tide for Theta Sigma Phi…  or unleash consequences no one could’ve predicted?

results.title: Girl on Edge
results.overview: Figure skater Jiang struggles to salvage her career under the ruthless eye of her mother and coach, Wang. At the rink, she finds a kindred spirit in Zhong. But when Wang begins to train Zhong, tension builds and Jiang’s ambition spirals into destructive obsession.

results.title: Passionate Women
results.overview: Lilla, a forty-something couples therapist devoted to her family, is blindsided when her husband suddenly leaves her for a younger nail technician. Struggling with heartbreak, Lilla finds herself being pushed by her headstrong daughter, Zsófi, and her no-nonsense mother, Vilma, to snap out of her depression and start dating again. In a bid to lift her spirits, Vilma introduces Lilla to a charming journalist — but things take an unexpected turn when Zsófi discovers a potential match of her own for her mother.
